selected_evidence.requirement: node2 (lan-a) can reach node3 (lan-b) on TCP/5432
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline open connectivity, then post-firewall and post-all-three-restarts checks all show node2 successfully connecting to node3:5432 and receiving the test banner.

selected_evidence.requirement: All other traffic between lan-a and lan-b is rejected
selected_evidence.summary: Ping node2->node3, ping node3->node2, TCP/8080 node2->node3, and node3->node2:5432 all fail/timeout under the VyOS forward-filter policy, both before and after the restart cycle.

selected_evidence.requirement: VyOS forward-filter firewall policy is correctly configured
selected_evidence.summary: show firewall output on node1 confirms default-action drop, established/related accept rules, and the explicit tcp/5432 eth1->eth2 accept rule with correct match conditions.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline config captured (boot_id 5bcff8f9...), reboot acknowledged, post-boot boot_id is 193b977d... (changed), and firewall/interfaces/ip_forward all show the same committed config after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 192f6cab... captured, reboot acknowledged, post-boot boot_id is 8376d9fe... (changed), and eth1 IP/route plus node2->node3 firewall behavior verified intact afterward.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ef457a88... captured, reboot acknowledged, post-boot boot_id is b7df436a... (changed), eth1 IP and firewalld port persisted, and end-to-end connectivity re-verified after restarting the killed test listener.
